worldcombat.skill.steelroller.summary: Crush the terrain under you entirely, take its colour into the wheel and roll out as a steel wheel; with no active terrain underfoot the whole move fails and its PP is still spent.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.0: Crush the terrain underfoot and roll through
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.1: Trade a patch of terrain for one continuous run
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.2: Carve a passable lane across the battlefield
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.descriptio: The wheel deals about %1$s physical damage and rolls up to %2$s blocks. It can only be used while standing on an active terrain, which it crushes entirely; with no terrain underfoot the whole move fails and its PP is still spent.

It rolls %1$s blocks per tick with a %2$s-block hit radius; it can roll through the targets in its path, hitting at most as many as the terrains it crushed (at least 1, at most 3, each target only once), shoving each aside by %3$s blocks; solid walls stop it and only short-lived steel shavings mark the ground it really crossed.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.grind.on: Grind on: power +18% and denser steel shavings, but a shorter roll (distance x0.8), speed x0.9, recovery +5 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.grind.off: Grind off: a cruise, rolling farther and faster and recovering cleanly, at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; %2$s after starting it spends %4$s PP; recovery %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.growth.0: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.growth.1: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s and the roll reaches %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.preference: On: power +18% and denser steel shavings, but a shorter roll (distance x0.8), speed x0.9, recovery +5 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off: a cruise, rolling farther and faster and recovering cleanly, at slightly lower power.
Only roll when the target is this close; the roll distance is moderate, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
